title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Light dark glass surfaces now dual CSS custom-property packs [data-glass-preset]. Switching preset longer requires recompiling Sass reloading page. Apps overrode Sass-$glass-* tokens target --glass-* CSS variables ([data-glass-preset="dark"]) instead. glass_theme() always builds Bootstrap 5 base theme (Bootswatch darkly dark). Dark appearance comes CSS variable pack light↔︎dark can toggle live. Visuals match 0.1.x closely; relied darkly-specific chrome outside glass surfaces, re-check dark mode. Private escape hatch window.__shinyglassDisableTint still works, supported API glass_theme(tint = FALSE) / update_glass_theme(tint = …).

title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Runtime light/dark switching via document.documentElement.dataset.glassPreset without full reload. glass_theme(preset = "auto") follows prefers-color-scheme updates OS theme changes. [update_glass_theme()] change preset, tint, primary (live accent via --glass-accent / --bs-primary) server. Recolors primary buttons, Shiny checkboxInput() / radios / switches, ion.rangeSlider bars, value chips, active nav/list items without Sass recompile. [glass_theme_toggle()] / [observe_glass_theme_toggle()] drop-Light / Dark / Auto buttons. Behavior knobs [glass_theme()]: tint, specular, nav_morph (default TRUE, matching 0.1.x JS behavior). Client helpers: window.shinyglass.setPreset() / .getPreset() / .setTint() / .setPrimary() / .getPrimary().

title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: DataTables / Bootstrap pagination chips: style visible .page-link surface (DT uses <li.paginate_button><.page-link>). Fixes solid black page numbers light-grey ellipsis chips dark mode dashboard demo / README screenshots. Visual QA harness: inst/scripts/audit-glass-contrast.R (+ .js) runs dual-theme computed-style audit (low contrast, solid-black chips, Bootstrap light greys dark, dark ink accent, DT pagination structure) across demo / dashboard / inputs-gallery. Checklist definition done inst/scripts/VISUAL-QA.md. Selectize fields: force body/menu ink inputs multi-select tags (selectize default near-black item text failed dark mode); opaque --glass-menu-bg fills dark; dropdown options use menu colors. Ecosystem chrome: plotly modebar + frame, gt tables, waiter / shinybusy overlays, shinyalert/SweetAlert2 popups, denser shinydashboardPlus controlbar/dropdowns/user menu, light rhandsontable / echarts/highcharter hosts. Examples: plotly-gt-demo.R, shinydashboardPlus-glass-demo.R. Live demo shinyglass-plotly-gt; README light/dark screenshots plotly+gt. CI workflow visual-qa (testthat + dual-theme contrast audit) committed inst/scripts/audit-baseline.json. Active--accent contrast: lower Bootstrap $min-contrast-ratio 3 color-contrast() picks white brand blues/purples (white #007AFF ~4.02:1 failed old 4.5 gate). Solid .bg-* / .text-bg-* fills (including bslib::value_box(theme=)) get luminance-based ink via glass-() / --glass--* — body color solid primary. Safety nets remain checks, radios, switches, pagination, list-group active. Accent rules target Shiny markup (.shiny-input-checkbox) well Bootstrap .form-check-input. Plot / image outputs get softer glass frame (lighter nesting inside cards). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables nav morph, specular, tint sampling, decorative transitions (JS + CSS). Demo bslib dashboard examples: theme toggle helper; dashboard accent select calls update_glass_theme(primary = …). Vignettes cover migration, primary updates, toggle helper, reduced motion. Unit tests cover dual CSS packs, head script knobs, active-color vars, update_glass_theme() messaging.

title: shinyglass 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-02 Fix: bslib::sidebar() / page_sidebar() layout longer collapses full-width stack. Glass floating-sidebar rules now win bslib’s later position/width cascade, open sidebars reserve space main value boxes cards stay fully visible beside chrome (). Fix: nested layout_sidebar() longer double-floats. Inner sidebars keep glass styling use bslib’s -flow grid content pushed large empty gutter beside second absolute panel. Improve: AdminLTE chrome (classic shinydashboard bs4Dash) gets stronger glass overlay — translucent header/sidebar, soft-tinted value/info boxes, clearer menu active states — without breaking AdminLTE layout.

title: shinyglass 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-28 Initial release. glass_theme() returns bslib theme Liquid Glass styling shiny apps: translucent surfaces, backdrop blur, soft depth, system typography. Light dark presets, options accent color, blur, saturation, corner radius. Works fluidPage(), navbarPage(), bslib::page_sidebar(), page functions accept bslib theme. Pass theme via theme = glass_theme(), teal apps via options(teal.bs_theme = glass_theme()). Styles common Bootstrap Shiny surfaces (cards, navbars, sidebars, inputs, tables, plots, modals) holds denser UIs leaflet maps, DT, shinyWidgets, bs4Dash, teal filter panels.
